title: Lineage
tagline: An evolution RTS where ancestors discover something and later generations discover what else it can do.
stateNote: The README describes a first vertical slice, The First Winter. The hosted menu also shows a story campaign and online rooms I haven't checked.
problem: Most strategy games reset knowledge every match. In Lineage discoveries are inherited, so civilizations branch over generations.
audience: Strategy fans and anyone curious about inherited-knowledge mechanics.
contribution: It is my project. The repo includes a CLAUDE.md development brief and a design concept document.
worksToday: Choose Humans or Neanderthals and play The First Winter, a 20 to 30 minute scenario, per the README.
The hosted build loads a main menu with campaign, skirmish and tutorial options.
limitations: I only checked that the hosted menu loads.

ai.note: The repository includes a CLAUDE.md development brief for AI coding assistants.
